answer: PHP code <?php ... ?> ke andar likha jata hai. echo se text screen par dikhta hai. File ko .php save karo aur terminal me php file.php se chalao, ya browser me server se kholo.
code:
<?php
echo "Hello, Prabh!";
print "\nPHP chal raha hai.";
?>
pitfall: HTML file me PHP code nahi chalega - file ka naam .php hona chahiye aur PHP installed hona chahiye.
title: Pehla PHP program - echo aur PHP tags
output:
Hello, Prabh!
PHP chal raha hai.

answer: Har variable $ se shuru hota hai. Type likhna nahi padta - value se type ban jata hai. var_dump() se type aur value dono dikhte hain.
code:
<?php
$name = "Prabh";   // string
$age = 19;        // int
$price = 99.5;    // float
$isStudent = true; // bool
$marks = [90, 85, 92]; // array
var_dump($name, $age, $marks);
?>
pitfall: $Name aur $name alag variables hain - PHP variable names case-sensitive hote hain.
title: Variables aur data types

answer: if me shart true ho to pehla block chalta hai, warna else. == sirf value check karta hai, === value + type dono - hamesha === use karo jahan ho sake. Chhoti shart ke liye ternary ?: use hota hai.
code:
<?php
$age = 19;
if ($age >= 18) {
    echo "Adult";
} elseif ($age >= 13) {
    echo "Teen";
} else {
    echo "Child";
}
echo "\n";
// ternary
$label = ($age >= 18) ? "Adult" : "Minor";
// === vs ==
var_dump(0 == "0");   // true
var_dump(0 === "0");  // false
?>
pitfall: if ($a = 5) likhne se compare nahi hota, assign ho jata hai - comparison ke liye == ya === likho.
title: if / else aur comparison - == vs ===

answer: for jab count pata ho, foreach jab array ke har item par kaam ho, while jab shart par rukna ho. break loop tod deta hai, continue ek round skip karta hai.
code:
<?php
for ($i = 1; $i <= 3; $i++) {
    echo $i . " ";
}
$names = ["Aman", "Riya", "Prabh"];
foreach ($names as $name) {
    echo $name . "\n";
}
$count = 0;
while ($count < 3) {
    $count++;
}
?>
pitfall: while loop me counter badhana mat bhoolo, warna loop kabhi nahi rukega.
title: Loops - for, foreach, while

answer: function keyword se function banta hai. Parameter andar aane wali value hai, return bahar jaane wali. Default value dene se parameter optional ho jata hai.
code:
<?php
function greet(string $name, string $time = "morning"): string {
    return "Good $time, $name!";
}
echo greet("Prabh");
echo greet("Prabh", "evening");
?>
pitfall: return ke baad likha code nahi chalta. Function ke andar ki variable bahar nahi dikhti.
title: Functions - apna function kaise banaye

answer: String jodne ke liye PHP me + nahi, dot (.) use hota hai. ?? ka matlab hai: left side set aur null nahi hai to wahi, warna right side. % se remainder milta hai.
pitfall: "5" + 2 = 7 hota hai, lekin "5" . 2 = "52" hota hai. + aur . ko mix mat karo.
title: Operators - arithmetic, string aur null coalescing

answer: Constant ki value ek baar set hone ke baad badli nahi ja sakti. define() kahin bhi chalta hai, const class ke andar aur top-level par use hota hai. Constant ka naam $ ke bina likha jata hai.
code:
<?php
define("SITE_NAME", "My Shop");
const TAX_RATE = 0.18;
echo SITE_NAME;
echo TAX_RATE;
?>
pitfall: Constant ko $ mat lagao - $SITE_NAME galat hai, SITE_NAME sahi hai.
title: Constants - define aur const

answer: switch ek value ko kai cases se milata hai. match PHP 8 ka chhota aur strict version hai - ye value return karta hai aur === se compare karta hai, isliye break ki zaroorat nahi.
code:
<?php
$day = "Mon";
switch ($day) {
    case "Mon": echo "Monday"; break;
    case "Sun": echo "Sunday"; break;
    default: echo "Other day";
}
$label = match ($day) {
    "Mon" => "Monday",
    "Sun" => "Sunday",
    default => "Other day",
};
echo $label;
?>
pitfall: switch me break bhool gaye to agla case bhi chal jayega. match me default na ho aur koi case na mile to error aayega.
title: switch aur match (PHP 8)

answer: Ek line ke liye // ya #, kai lines ke liye /* ... */ use karo. Comments run nahi hote, sirf padhne wale ke liye hote hain.
code:
<?php
// Ye ek line ka comment hai
# Ye bhi ek line ka comment hai
/*
  Ye kai lines ka
  comment hai
*/
echo "Hi"; // line ke end par bhi comment chalega
?>
pitfall: Comment ke andar <?php likhne se bhi code nahi chalega - wo bhi comment hi rahega.
title: Comments - code me note kaise likhe

answer: Terminal me php file.php se script chalti hai. Command ke baad likhe words $argv array me aate hain - $argv[0] khud file ka naam hota hai. User se input ke liye STDIN se fgets() padho.
code:
<?php
// php greet.php Prabh
$name = $argv[1] ?? "Guest";
echo "Hello, $name!\n";
// Input lena:
// echo "Naam likho: ";
// $input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
?>
pitfall: $argv sirf CLI me milta hai, browser me nahi. Browser me input ke liye $_GET/$_POST use karo.
title: CLI - terminal se PHP chalana aur $argv

answer: include file nahi mili to warning dekar aage chalega, require file nahi mili to fatal error dekar ruk jayega. _once wala version file ko ek hi baar jodta hai, dobara jodne se function dobara define hone ka error nahi aata.
pitfall: Function ya class wali file ko bina _once ke do baar joda to 'cannot redeclare' error aayega.
title: include / require - ek file ko dusri me jodna

answer: Seekhte waqt error_reporting(E_ALL) aur display_errors on rakho taaki galti dikhe. Live site par display_errors off rakho aur error_log me likho. var_dump() type + value dikhata hai, print_r() array ko padhne layak dikhata hai.
code:
<?php
error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', '1');
$data = ['a' => 1, 'b' => 2];
var_dump($data);
print_r($data);
// Production me:
// ini_set('display_errors', '0');
// ini_set('log_errors', '1');
?>
pitfall: Live site par display_errors on rakhna galat hai - user ko andar ki jaankari dikh jayegi. Wahan sirf log karo.
title: Errors aur debugging - var_dump, error reporting

answer: date() se aaj ki date/time format me milti hai. DateTime class se date jodna/ghatana aur compare karna aasan hai. India ke liye timezone Asia/Kolkata set karo, warna server ka time dikhega.
code:
<?php
date_default_timezone_set("Asia/Kolkata");
echo date("d-m-Y H:i"); // 29-10-2026 10:02
$today = new DateTime();
$today->modify("+7 days");
echo $today->format("d-m-Y");
$ts = strtotime("2026-11-02");
echo date("d F Y", $ts);
?>
pitfall: date() bina timezone set kiye server ke timezone ka time dega - India me hamesha Asia/Kolkata set karo.
title: Date aur time - date(), DateTime, timezone

answer: round() nearest, ceil() upar, floor() neeche round karta hai. Security wale kaam (OTP, token) ke liye rand() nahi, random_int() use karo - wo cryptographically safe hai.
code:
<?php
echo round(4.6);  // 5
echo ceil(4.1);   // 5
echo floor(4.9);  // 4
echo abs(-7);     // 7
echo pow(2, 10);  // 1024
echo max(3, 9, 4); // 9
$otp = random_int(100000, 999999);
?>
pitfall: OTP/password reset token ke liye rand() mat use karo - wo predict ho sakta hai. random_int() use karo.
title: Math - round, random, min/max

answer: Value ke aage (int), (float), (string) likh kar type badla jata hai. File ke upar declare(strict_types=1); likhne se function me galat type aane par error aayega, chupchaap convert nahi hoga.
pitfall: (int) "abc" = 0 ho jata hai bina error ke - user input ko cast karne se pehle validate karo.
title: Type casting aur strict types
